name: kdc-wacr-recoveryflow
description: Development tooling for RecoveryFlow by WA.cr. The plugin ships one hand-written frontend script and no built assets, so there is no build step.

scripts.a11y:seed: wp-env run cli wp --require=/var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$PWD")/tests/a11y/seed.php recoveryflow-a11y seed --yes
scripts.a11y:clear: wp-env run cli wp --require=/var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/$(basename "$PWD")/tests/a11y/seed.php recoveryflow-a11y clear --yes
